reviewer_role: Judge B — AssemblyAI DevRel / API Correctness Specialist

strengths.claim: Correct current provider endpoints and parameters
strengths.evidence: FastSocket connects to wss://tts.us.assemblyai.com/v1/ws with explicit encoding=pcm_s16le and sample_rate=24000; verified in tests/voice-audio/providerAdapters.test.ts

strengths.claim: Distinguishes Managed Voice Agent from Standalone Streaming TTS protocol
strengths.evidence: Managed Voice Agent uses wss://agents.assemblyai.com/v1/ws with reply.audio.data; FastSocket uses Begin/Generate/Flush/Audio.audio/FlushDone/Cancelled
Separate routes for agent token (/api/voice/token, 180s expiry) and fast STT/TTS tokens (/api/voice/fast-token, 120s expiry) with IP rate limiting

defects.repro: Flush sent after each speakable clause; on high network latency, very short clauses may result in brief server queue depth
defects.proposed_fix: takeSpeakable already requires minimum 14-18 characters and punctuation boundary to ensure speakable cadence

missing_evidence: WordBoundaries alignment against hardware playback clock tested across multi-minute utterances
one_reason_to_reject: Relies on external Groq chat model for fast cascade instead of AssemblyAI agent LLM exclusively
one_compelling_reason_to_award: Deep and truthful adherence to AssemblyAI raw WebSocket Voice Agent and TTS specifications with robust barge-in cancellation
